agent_explanation: Hover body reaches and dwells exactly on final waypoint (position equals waypoint, speed ~1e-12) for many steps, then position/velocity and energy become non-finite at step 1729. This pattern indicates controller waypoint logic divides by distance-to-target (normalize zero vector) or similar 0/0 when switching/holding at final waypoint with zero velocity error, producing NaN that poisons integration. Disabling the controller removes the failure.
